# Smart Planar Reflector runtime source

Upstream: https://github.com/KipJM/smart_planar_reflector

Pinned commit: `38df2bbf84c9ad1982dc7758e66f9809467ed973` (MIT, copyright 2025 Kip).
`planar_reflector.gd` is the unmodified upstream
`addons/smart_planar_reflector/Internal/PlanarReflector.gd`, with its license and
upstream inspiration credits retained beside it. No editor plugin, demo assets,
or upstream material is installed. The OpenRC lake adapter supplies its existing
water material and owns activation, camera selection, masks and cleanup.
